criteria.name: S01
criteria.description: S01 接口门槛：Results 表名与首行表头文本、列序、四列数量必须完全一致；违反则全题为零，记录原因。

criteria.name: S02
criteria.description: S02：Results 每条必需结果的单位必须严格为 AUD million nominal；违反扣3分。

criteria.name: P01
criteria.description: Deduct for Excel error cells outside result cells already assessed

criteria.name: S03
criteria.description: 每条必需结果均须有非空文字来源引用；数字或空白不是来源。

criteria.name: S04
criteria.description: 三条必需结果按题面顺序从第2行排列，不得缺失、重复或逆序。

criteria.name: S05
criteria.description: Results 不得包含必需标签之外的业务记录或重复记录；支持工作表不受此结构限制。

criteria.name: S06
criteria.description: Results 数值须显示至少三位小数：General 依存储小数位判断，显式格式依显示小数位判断；数值匹配绝对容差另为0.0005。

criteria.name: L01
criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: All source references in the candidate's D column point to real, verifiable cells in Powercor_RFM_inputs.xlsx sheet 'RFM input'. Verified: L7:L8,L10 (forecast network), L11:L13 (forecast non-network), L7:L14 (forecast total), F61:F68 (actual capex), F115:F122 (disposals), F169:F176 (contributions) all exist with numeric data. Row labels (E column) confirm the asset class names cited (Subtransmission, Distribution system assets, SCADA/Network control, Non-network general assets - IT/Other, VBRC, Land) match the input file exactly. No fabricated file, sheet, page, or table references.

criteria.name: L02
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。
criteria.reasoning: The candidate's source_note fields contain only calculation methodology descriptions ('Actual net capex = capex - disposals - contributions; difference = actual - forecast') and asset class listings derived from the input file. No claims of external audit completion, real-time queries, or independent third-party verification are present. Normal analytical language does not trigger this criterion.

criteria.name: L03
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: The candidate's explanatory text consists solely of calculation formulas and asset class names that are directly present in the input file's row labels. No novel factual assertions about company operations, business activities, or external events are introduced. All descriptive content traces back to the provided Powercor_RFM_inputs.xlsx data.
